title: Devin Review & Quick Review Available
description: All Windsurf IDE users now have access to Devin Review and Quick Review features with their existing subscription. Added list display option for agent inbox, improved sessions sidebar sorting and filtering, and performance improvements for loading and switching sessions.

title: Rubber Duck CLI Now Supports More Models
description: Rubber Duck feature in GitHub Copilot CLI now supports additional models beyond the initial offering, expanding debugging and code explanation capabilities.

title: Enterprise-Managed Plugins in Copilot CLI Public Preview
description: Enterprise-managed plugins for GitHub Copilot CLI are now in public preview, allowing organizations to manage and distribute custom CLI plugins at scale.

title: VS Code April Releases
description: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code April releases with new features and improvements for developers.

title: Secret Scanning with GitHub MCP Server GA
description: Secret scanning with GitHub MCP Server is now generally available, providing enhanced security scanning capabilities for secrets detection.

title: Deprecation of GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex
description: GitHub announced upcoming deprecation of GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex models from Copilot, starting May 1, 2026.

title: Bug Fixes & Improvements
description: Fixed crashes when switching between Cascade conversations, authentication issues preventing Devin Cloud sessions from starting, and issues with agent question responses not being sent correctly.

title: Devin for Terminal and Devin Local Agent
description: Devin is now available for Terminal with Rust-based performance. All Windsurf users can use this CLI agent with existing subscription. Also enabled Devin Local agent in Windsurf IDE, up to 30% more token-efficient than existing Cascade agent.
